passages.text: Max soon realises that Jane's adopted son Bobby Beale (Eliot Carrington) is Lucy's killer all along and that Jane had been covering up for her. He then discovers that Lauren knew the truth and disowns her as the police arrive to arrest him once more. As he is being arrested, Max shouts out to everyone that Bobby killed Lucy but they all dismiss his claims as an act of desperation; Max is later sentenced to life imprisonment with a recommendation he should serve at least 21 years.
